title: Identification of Novel Plasma Protein Biomarkers for Early Clinical Stage Colorectal Carcinoma by High-Throughput Proteomics.
snippet: Early detection is critical for improving survival in colorectal carcinoma (CRC), underscoring the need for reliable early-stage biomarkers. Plasma protein biomarkers may support the detection of early-stage CRC.
